title: Artikel nicht gefunden | BILLA Online Shop

knownGaps.why: NOT a limitation, a live defect recorded so the suite stays green. BILLA renders the shelf price as a superscript split: 1,80 €180 €. The canonical price carries class d-sr-only, which walker.ts:291's substring regex treats as accessibility text and skips, but A11Y_TEXT_SELECTOR only matches the exact class .sr-only, so accessiblePriceText never offers it. The superscript fragment '80 €' is then converted as 80 euros: 0.1118 ZEC for a 1,80 € carton, 44x too high. The differing shapes are that bogus figure sitting beside the correct per-litre ones. Delete this entry when the two sr-only rules are reconciled.
